title: fix(objectql): a read-only secret field keeps its stored value on update
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:更新记录时,`readonlyWhen` 谓词为真而锁定的 `secret` 字段、以及静态 `readonly` 的 `secret` 字段,不再接受调用方写入;按 id 与按谓词(`multi`)两条更新路径都保持存储值,并像其它只读字段一样报告丢弃(`onFieldsDropped`、`X-ObjectStack-Dropped-Fields`、`strictReadonlyWrites` 拒绝)。
- 为什么改:规则是「调用方不可写的字段保持存储值,无论字段类型」,`secret` 字段同样适用。
- 风险与回滚:只涉及更新路径上两道只读剥离对 `secret` 字段的作者判定,以及 `sys_secret` 行只在语句仍引用它时写入;未锁定的 `secret` 照旧加密存为引用,hook 写入的值照旧保留。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/engine-update-sealed-secrets.ts`(判定本身);`packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts` 两个分支的调用点与两处 `persistSecretRows`;`packages/objectql/src/engine-update-locked-secret.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-update-locked-secret.test.ts`,预期 12/12 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A field the caller may not write keeps its stored value, whatever its type. This PR makes that hold for a `secret` field on both update paths, by id and by predicate (`multi: true`):

- A `secret` field locked by a TRUE `readonlyWhen`, or declared static `readonly`, takes no caller write: the stored reference is unchanged and no `sys_secret` row is written for the value sent.
- The read-only strips report the field as they report any other: `onFieldsDropped` (`readonly_when` / `readonly`), the REST `droppedFields` body and `X-ObjectStack-Dropped-Fields` header, and the `strictReadonlyWrites` refusal (`ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED`).
- New `packages/objectql/src/engine-update-sealed-secrets.ts`: authorship of each `secret` key is read immediately before the credential pass, and both strips (and the views they build) judge a submission in which each caller-held key carries the reference that stands for the caller's value. A sealed `sys_secret` row is written only when the payload handed to the statement still names it.
- Unchanged: an unlocked `secret` is sealed and stored as a reference; a value a `beforeUpdate` hook writes on a locked `secret` is the hook's and is kept; hooks read `ctx.submitted` as before. As for every `readonlyWhen` field, `isSystem` does not exempt a caller value on a locked `secret`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-update-locked-secret.test.ts` (new, 12 cases), by id and by predicate: a `readonlyWhen`-locked secret and a static `readonly` secret keep their stored value and are reported; `strictReadonlyWrites` refuses with `ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED` naming both and writes nothing; `isSystem` does not exempt the `readonlyWhen` lock; controls: an unlocked secret is sealed and stored as a reference, a hook-written value on a locked secret is kept (alone, and over a caller value).
- `packages/rest/src/rest-update-locked-secret.test.ts` (new, 2 cases): `PATCH /data/:object/:id` on the locked secrets answers 200 with both fields in `droppedFields` and the header, stored references unchanged; control: an unlocked secret through the same door is sealed and stored as a reference.

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: no`. The declared contract already states the rule: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, `readonly` — "server-enforced on BOTH write paths: a non-system write to this field is silently dropped from the payload on UPDATE and on INSERT ... symmetric with `readonlyWhen`". No spec, schema, export or error code changes; no published accept set or surface widens.

The failure was the multi hook control's own construction (its handler keyed on a value it rewrote, so the matched rows' handlers wrote different keys and the engine refused the write as designed); fixed in `3524713e38`.
